title: Advantages and Disadvantages of Remote Working
prompt: Write an essay discussing the advantages and disadvantages of working from home.
student_text:
Nowadays, remote working is becoming more popular everyday. In my opinion, working from home have many positive aspects, although it also brings some serious disadvantages for workers.

Firstly, people save a lot of time because they dont must commute to the office in crowded trains. This allow them to spend more valuable time with their families and avoid unnecessary stress.

On the other hand, workers can feel isolated from their colleagues. Communication is often slow, and it is more difficult to create a strong teamwork culture when people dont see each other.

To conclude, despite the lack of social interaction, I truly believe that flexible hybrid models are the best solution for modern society.
teacher_notes: Solid B2 essay with good paragraphing. Minor grammar slips (everyday, dont must).

title: Improving Academic Resources at Get Idiomas

student_text:
Improving Academic Resources at Get Idiomas

Introduction: The aim of this proposal is to evaluate current educational materials and suggest actionable improvements for advanced cohorts.

Current Situation: Students consistently report limited access to authentic exam simulations and specialized Cambridge vocabulary workshops.

Recommendations: Firstly, introducing interactive digital revision modules would foster autonomous study habits. Secondly, organizing bi-weekly speaking clinics would significantly boost learners fluency and confidence.

title: An Unforgettable Day in the Mountains
prompt: Write a story beginning with: When I woke up, the sun was shining...
student_text: When I woke up, the sun was shining and the birds were singing. My brother and I decided to climb the mountain near our village. We packed some sandwiches, apples and bottles of water in our backpacks. The path was very steep, but the view was wonderful. Suddenly, black clouds appeared in the sky and it started raining heavily. We were completely wet and cold. Fortunately, we found a small wooden cabin where an old shepherd invited us to drink hot tea. It was an unforgettable adventure that taught us to always check the weather forecast.

title: Inviting a Friend to My Birthday Party
prompt: Write an email inviting your friend Alex to your birthday celebration.
student_text: Hi Alex, I hope you are doing well! As you know, next Saturday is my fifteenth birthday and I am organizing a party at my house. We are going to have a barbecue in the garden and listen to music. Most of our classmates from school are coming too. The party starts at 6 pm and finishes around 11 pm. Can you bring your guitar? We would love to sing some songs together. Please let me know if you can come before Thursday. Hope to see you there! Best, Mateo

title: The Mystery of the Lost Key
prompt: Write a story ending with: I will never forget that mysterious key.
student_text: Last summer I was walking on the beach when I saw something shining under the sand. It was an old golden key with strange symbols carved on it. I showed it to my grandfather, who has lived by the coast all his life. He smiled and took me to our basement. In the corner, there was a heavy wooden chest covered in dust. I put the key inside the lock and turned it carefully. The chest opened, revealing old letters and photographs from my great-grandparents. I will never forget that mysterious key.

title: Advice for Visiting Barcelona
prompt: Write an email giving travel tips to your penfriend.
student_text: Dear Sarah, Im so happy to hear that you are visiting Barcelona next month! You will definitely love the city. First of all, you should visit the Sagrada Familia and Park Guell, but make sure to book tickets online in advance. Also, dont forget to walk down Las Ramblas and try some delicious tapas in the Gothic Quarter. The public transport is cheap and easy to use. Wear comfortable shoes because you will walk a lot. Write back if you need any more recommendations! Warm regards, Lucas

title: My Favorite Hobby: Playing Basketball
prompt: Write an article about your favorite sport or hobby for the school magazine.
student_text: Playing basketball is more than just a hobby for me; it is a passion. I started playing when I was eight years old with my cousins in our local park. What I like most about basketball is that it requires great teamwork and quick thinking. You have to run fast, pass accurately and communicate constantly with your teammates. Furthermore, it keeps me healthy and helps me relieve stress after school exams. If you have never tried basketball, I strongly encourage you to give it a shot!

title: Apologizing for Missing English Class
prompt: Write an email to your teacher explaining why you missed class.
student_text: Dear Mrs. Martinez, I am writing to apologize for not attending our English lesson yesterday afternoon. Unfortunately, I had a sudden dental appointment because I broke a tooth during lunch. Could you please let me know which grammar exercises we covered and what homework was assigned? I want to make sure I dont fall behind before the test next Tuesday. Thank you very much for your understanding. Sincerely, Daniel

title: A Strange Phone Call at Midnight
prompt: Write a story starting with: The phone rang at midnight...
student_text: The phone rang at midnight, breaking the silence of the dark house. I jumped out of bed, feeling scared and confused. When I answered, a whisper said: Look outside your window right now. My hands were shaking as I opened the curtains. To my surprise, my friends were standing on the lawn holding a huge banner and singing happy birthday. I had completely forgotten that today was my sixteenth birthday! It was the best surprise ever.

title: Asking for Information About a Summer Camp
prompt: Write an email asking for details about an adventure camp.
student_text: Dear Camp Director, I saw your advertisement about the summer adventure camp in the Pyrenees and I would like to ask a few questions. Could you please inform me about the exact dates and the price for a two-week stay? Also, do participants need to bring their own camping equipment, or is it provided? Finally, are vegetarian meal options available? I look forward to hearing from you soon. Yours faithfully, Lucia Gomez

title: Why Learning English is Useful for Teens
prompt: Write an article for students about the importance of English.
student_text: English has become the universal language of communication. Nowadays, learning English allows teenagers to enjoy movies, listen to songs and read books in their original version. In addition, it is essential for traveling and meeting people from diverse cultural backgrounds. Finally, speaking good English opens up fantastic university opportunities and future careers. In conclusion, every minute you spend studying English today is an investment in your future.

title: The Broken Bicycle
prompt: Write a story about a bicycle trip that went wrong.
student_text: Tom and I were riding our bicycles along the river when my front tire suddenly popped. We were miles away from the nearest town and neither of us had a repair kit. We decided to walk pushing our bikes under the hot sun. After two hours, an old truck stopped and the driver offered us a ride home. We were exhausted but relieved.

title: Should Mobile Phones Be Banned in Schools?
prompt: Write an essay discussing whether mobile phones should be prohibited in schools.
student_text:
In contemporary society, mobile phones have become an integral part of young peoples daily routines. However, their presence in academic environments remains a subject of intense controversy.

On the one hand, proponents of a ban argue that smartphones are a major source of distraction during lessons. Students frequently check social media notifications instead of concentrating on classroom explanations. Furthermore, excessive phone usage can lead to cyberbullying and reduced face-to-face socialisation during breaks.

On the other hand, smartphones can serve as valuable educational tools when used responsibly. They provide instant access to online dictionaries, educational applications, and research materials. Additionally, having a phone allows students to contact their parents in case of an emergency.

In conclusion, rather than implementing a total prohibition, schools should establish clear guidelines that regulate phone usage while embracing their educational benefits.

title: Discovering My Hometown: A Hidden Gem
prompt: Write an article describing what makes your town special for visitors.
student_text:
Are you looking for an authentic travel destination away from overcrowded tourist spots? Let me introduce you to my hometown, a charming coastal town that seamlessly blends rich history with modern vibrancy.

First and foremost, the historic quarter is a marvel to explore on foot. Its narrow cobbled alleys are lined with colorful houses and traditional taverns where you can savor freshly caught seafood. Furthermore, the local castle perched atop the hill offers breathtaking panoramic views of the Mediterranean coastline, especially at sunset.

For outdoor enthusiasts, the surrounding nature reserve provides scenic cycling trails and pristine beaches. Whether you are seeking cultural immersion or peaceful relaxation, my town has something for everyone. Pack your bags and experience it for yourself!

title: Review of Inception: A Mind-Bending Masterpiece
prompt: Write a review of a movie that left a lasting impression on you.
student_text:
Directed by Christopher Nolan, Inception is undeniably one of the most intellectually stimulating science-fiction films of the 21st century.

The plot revolves around Dom Cobb, a skilled thief who specializes in the dangerous art of extraction: stealing valuable corporate secrets from deep within the subconscious during the dream state. Leonardo DiCaprio delivers a compelling performance, portraying Cobbs emotional vulnerability and grief with remarkable nuance. Moreover, Hans Zimmers powerful musical score amplifies the tension in every scene.

What sets Inception apart is its visually stunning practical effects and complex narrative structure. The concept of dreams within dreams challenges the audience to remain fully engaged from start to finish.

I whole-heartedly recommend this cinematic triumph to anyone who appreciates thought-provoking cinema.

title: Complaint Regarding a Disappointing Hotel Stay
prompt: Write a formal email of complaint to a hotel manager.
student_text:
Dear Hotel Manager,

I am writing to express my profound dissatisfaction regarding my recent stay at your hotel from November 10th to 14th (Reservation Reference #78491).

Upon our arrival, we were informed that our booked sea-view suite was unavailable, and we were relocated to a significantly smaller room overlooking a noisy construction site. To make matters worse, the air conditioning unit was malfunctioning, making it almost impossible to sleep. Despite reporting this issue to the reception desk on multiple occasions, no remedial action was taken throughout our four-night stay.

Given the substantial inconvenience suffered and the failure to deliver the services advertised, I request a refund of 50% of the total accommodation fee. I trust you will handle this matter promptly.

Yours faithfully,
Carlos Ramirez

title: Report on Local Youth Sports Facilities
prompt: Write a report evaluating municipal sports facilities for youth.
student_text:
Report on Local Youth Sports Facilities

Introduction:
The purpose of this report is to assess the condition and accessibility of sports amenities available to young residents in our district, and to recommend constructive improvements.

Current Situation:
While the central municipal sports complex offers decent swimming and football facilities, suburban neighborhoods suffer from a severe shortage of modern equipment. Many basketball courts have damaged surfaces and broken backboards, posing safety risks to young athletes.

Youth Feedback:
A recent survey revealed that 75% of teenagers feel that membership fees are prohibitively expensive, which discourages regular physical exercise.

Recommendations:
1. Allocate municipal funds to repair suburban outdoor courts immediately.
2. Introduce subsidized youth passes to make sports clubs accessible to lower-income families.

Conclusion:
Investing in youth sports will promote community health and foster social inclusion.

title: The Impact of Artificial Intelligence on the Future of Labour
prompt: Write an academic essay analyzing the implications of generative AI on professional employment.
student_text:
The meteoric ascent of artificial intelligence constitutes one of the most profound technological disruptions of our era. While technological optimists argue that AI will automate mundane chores and unleash human creativity, critics caution against widespread socioeconomic disenfranchisement.

Foremost among the transformative benefits is the substantial escalation in productive efficiency. In sectors such as healthcare, legal research, and software engineering, algorithmic processing empowers professionals to analyze colossal datasets with unprecedented precision. Consequently, diagnostic turnaround times have plummeted, enabling medical practitioners to focus primarily on compassionate patient care.

Conversely, the potential obsolescence of white-collar vocations poses a formidable threat to economic stability. Routine analytical duties, customer relations, and content synthesis are increasingly vulnerable to full automation. Without robust policy frameworks and continuous professional upskilling, the transition risks exacerbating wealth inequality and instigating chronic underemployment.

In conclusion, while the economic dividends of AI are undeniable, governments and educational institutions must proactively retool the workforce to ensure equitable technological progression.

title: Proposal to Establish an Environmental Sustainability Initiative
prompt: Write a formal proposal proposing concrete ecological policies for a corporate campus.
student_text:
Proposal: Transitioning Towards an Eco-Friendly Academic Campus

Introduction:
The objective of this proposal is to evaluate current ecological inefficiencies within our academic facilities and recommend actionable, high-impact strategies to minimize our carbon footprint.

Current Ecological Deficits:
An extensive energy audit revealed that lighting and heating systems remain operational overnight in unoccupied lecture halls, leading to substantial energy wastage. Furthermore, single-use plastic containers predominate in the cafeteria, contradicting the institutions stated sustainability ethos.

Proposed Measures:
1. Smart Infrastructure: Installing automated motion sensors and smart thermostats across all premises would curb electricity consumption by an estimated 25% within the first semester.
2. Circular Waste Strategy: Phasing out disposable cutlery in favor of reusable alternatives and instituting clearly labeled composting bins across common areas.

Expected Outcomes:
Beyond tangible reductions in operational expenditures, these initiatives will cultivate ecological responsibility among students.

Conclusion:
It is strongly advised that management allocate the required capital expenditure to initiate this green transition without delay.

title: Report on Contemporary Workplace Diversity and Inclusion Practices
prompt: Write a comprehensive report examining diversity policies and suggesting strategic enhancements.
student_text:
Report on Diversity and Inclusion within Regional Enterprises

Executive Summary:
This report synthesizes empirical findings regarding diversity initiatives across fifty local corporations and outlines strategic recommendations to foster an inclusive organizational culture.

Findings on Recruitment and Progression:
While 80% of surveyed organizations proclaim a formal commitment to equal opportunity, representation of marginalized demographics remains disproportionately scarce in senior managerial tiers. Unconscious bias during promotional appraisals was cited by 42% of respondents as a persistent impediment to career mobility.

Cultural Atmosphere:
Employees reported that mentorship programs are predominantly informal and lack measurable milestones, thereby failing to cultivate minority talent systematically.

Recommendations:
- Institutionalize blind performance evaluations to eradicate subjective bias.
- Establish structured sponsorship frameworks linking junior female and minority talent with executive leaders.

Conclusion:
Adopting these proactive measures will bolster employee retention, catalyze innovation, and burnish corporate prestige.

title: Review of Yuval Noah Hararis 21 Lessons for the 21st Century
prompt: Write an in-depth review evaluating a non-fiction book on global dilemmas.
student_text:
In 21 Lessons for the 21st Century, historian Yuval Noah Harari shifts his focus from broad historical arcs to the existential dilemmas confronting contemporary humanity. The treatise explores the nexus of biotechnology, infotech disruptions, political polarization, and the erosion of liberal democracies with captivating urgency.

Hararis prose is characterized by lucidity, sharp wit, and an enviable gift for distilling multifaceted philosophical enigmas into accessible paradigms. His critique of nationalism in an interconnected globalized reality is particularly incisive, compelling readers to interrogate complacency.

Nevertheless, the volume is not devoid of shortcomings. Certain chapters, notably those addressing secularism and mindfulness, lack the rigorous analytical depth found in Sapiens, occasionally bordering on platitudes.

Notwithstanding these minor caveats, the book remains indispensable reading for anyone endeavoring to make sense of our volatile, rapidly metamorphosing world.

title: Proposal to Establish an Environmental Sustainability Initiative (Cohort Variant 5)
prompt: Write a formal proposal proposing concrete ecological policies for a corporate campus.
student_text:
Proposal: Transitioning Towards an Eco-Friendly Academic Campus

Introduction:
The objective of this proposal is to evaluate current ecological inefficiencies within our academic facilities and recommend actionable, high-impact strategies to minimize our carbon footprint.

Current Ecological Deficits:
An extensive energy audit revealed that lighting and heating systems remain operational overnight in unoccupied lecture halls, leading to substantial energy wastage. Furthermore, single-use plastic containers predominate in the cafeteria, contradicting the institutions stated sustainability ethos.

Proposed Measures:
1. Smart Infrastructure: Installing automated motion sensors and smart thermostats across all premises would curb electricity consumption by an estimated 25% within the first semester.
2. Circular Waste Strategy: Phasing out disposable cutlery in favor of reusable alternatives and instituting clearly labeled composting bins across common areas.

Expected Outcomes:
Beyond tangible reductions in operational expenditures, these initiatives will cultivate ecological responsibility among students.

Conclusion:
It is strongly advised that management allocate the required capital expenditure to initiate this green transition without delay.

title: Report on Contemporary Workplace Diversity and Inclusion Practices (Cohort Variant 6)
prompt: Write a comprehensive report examining diversity policies and suggesting strategic enhancements.
student_text:
Report on Diversity and Inclusion within Regional Enterprises

Executive Summary:
This report synthesizes empirical findings regarding diversity initiatives across fifty local corporations and outlines strategic recommendations to foster an inclusive organizational culture.

Findings on Recruitment and Progression:
While 80% of surveyed organizations proclaim a formal commitment to equal opportunity, representation of marginalized demographics remains disproportionately scarce in senior managerial tiers. Unconscious bias during promotional appraisals was cited by 42% of respondents as a persistent impediment to career mobility.

Cultural Atmosphere:
Employees reported that mentorship programs are predominantly informal and lack measurable milestones, thereby failing to cultivate minority talent systematically.

Recommendations:
- Institutionalize blind performance evaluations to eradicate subjective bias.
- Establish structured sponsorship frameworks linking junior female and minority talent with executive leaders.

Conclusion:
Adopting these proactive measures will bolster employee retention, catalyze innovation, and burnish corporate prestige.

title: Review of Yuval Noah Hararis 21 Lessons for the 21st Century (Cohort Variant 7)
prompt: Write an in-depth review evaluating a non-fiction book on global dilemmas.
student_text:
In 21 Lessons for the 21st Century, historian Yuval Noah Harari shifts his focus from broad historical arcs to the existential dilemmas confronting contemporary humanity. The treatise explores the nexus of biotechnology, infotech disruptions, political polarization, and the erosion of liberal democracies with captivating urgency.

Hararis prose is characterized by lucidity, sharp wit, and an enviable gift for distilling multifaceted philosophical enigmas into accessible paradigms. His critique of nationalism in an interconnected globalized reality is particularly incisive, compelling readers to interrogate complacency.

Nevertheless, the volume is not devoid of shortcomings. Certain chapters, notably those addressing secularism and mindfulness, lack the rigorous analytical depth found in Sapiens, occasionally bordering on platitudes.

Notwithstanding these minor caveats, the book remains indispensable reading for anyone endeavoring to make sense of our volatile, rapidly metamorphosing world.

title: The Paradox of Hyper-Connectivity in the Digital Age
prompt: Write a philosophical essay exploring whether digital connectivity alienates society.
student_text:
The paradox of hyper-connectivity lies in the disquieting irony that as human beings become instantaneously reachable across boundless geographic expanses, the fabric of genuine empathetic communion steadily unravels. We inhabit an era marked by unprecedented communicative velocity, yet our interpersonal relationships are frequently reduced to ephemeral transactional exchanges mediated by glowing screens.

Central to this psychological predicament is the curated projection of the self. Social media platforms incentivize performative existence, wherein individuals meticulously cultivate an idealized digital persona while languishing in acute private isolation. The nuanced subtleties of face-to-face discourse—vocal timbre, hesitant pauses, somatic resonance—are inexorably flattened into algorithmic commodities designed to maximize dopamine-driven engagement rather than mutual comprehension.

Moreover, the relentless deluge of information inevitably erodes contemplative solitary thought. Deprived of restorative boredom, the human intellect struggles to synthesize profound philosophical insights, defaulting instead to reactionary cognitive biases and tribal polarization.

Ultimately, liberating modern society from this technological malaise requires an intentional re-evaluation of digital hygiene. We must vigorously reclaim analog spaces of communion and acknowledge that true connectivity is measured not by network bandwidth, but by emotional depth and presence.

title: The Resurgence of Artisanal Craftsmanship in a Mass-Produced World
prompt: Write a literary article examining the psychological appeal of handmade goods.
student_text:
In an age dominated by industrial homogenization and planned obsolescence, a quiet renaissance is taking root. Discerning consumers are turning away from the soulless efficiency of algorithmic mass manufacturing, seeking solace instead in the deliberate, tactile world of artisanal craftsmanship. Whether it is bespoke leatherwork, hand-thrown ceramics, or mechanical horology, handmade artifacts possess an indelible soul—an authentic narrative forged through patient human toil.

What accounts for this yearning? Beyond mere aesthetic distinction, engaging with handcrafted objects fulfills a profound psychological need for tangibility in an increasingly disembodied, virtual existence. In each subtle irregularity of the clay or hand-stitched seam lies a testament to human resilience and timeless dedication.

title: The Architecture of Solitude: Review of a Modernist Landmark
prompt: Write an architectural and cultural critique of a contemporary public building.
student_text:
Few architectural creations encapsulate the existential ambiguities of the post-industrial metropolis quite as magnificently as the newly unveiled civic library in Oslo. Conceived as a sanctuary of democratic erudition, the structure defies conventional geometric paradigms, folding monolithic concrete slabs into graceful, light-dappled cantilevers that appear to levitate above the frozen fjord.

Inside, the acoustic choreography is masterly. Despite hosting thousands of visitors daily, the interior resonates with a serene, contemplative hush. The juxtaposition of raw textured timber and polished glass establishes a sensory dialogue between Scandinavian vernacular traditions and futuristic ambition.

title: Linguistic Relativism and the Architecture of Human Consciousness
prompt: Write an academic essay exploring whether language shapes cognitive perception.
student_text:
The proposition that the linguistic architecture we inherit profoundly conditions the boundaries of human cognition—the Sapir-Whorf hypothesis—continues to spark vigorous debate among cognitive linguists and neuroscientists. While radical linguistic determinism has been largely supplanted, nuanced evidence demonstrates that grammatical categories subtly orient attention and recalibrate sensory perception.

Consider how cultures lacking egocentric spatial terminology orient themselves using absolute cardinal directions. Their spatial awareness is perpetually anchored to the cosmos, fostering an acute geographic orientation entirely alien to Western speakers reliant on relative terms like left and right. Language is not merely a transparent vessel for pre-existing thoughts; it is an active lens that colors our phenomenological reality.

title: The Vanishing Art of Deep Reading
prompt: Write an essay on the cognitive consequences of digital reading habits.
student_text: As digital skimming usurps sustained immersive reading, cognitive scientists warn of profound transformations in our neurocircuitry. The patience required to navigate dense syntactic labyrinths, unpack allegory, and synthesize dialectical arguments is being eroded by the frantic rhythms of hyperlinked browsing. To safeguard deep reading is to preserve our capacity for empathy, critical skepticism, and original thought.
